patthana15.52:1.1: kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no upādāno na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ. no
patthana15.52:2.1: upādānaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no upādāno na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
patthana15.52:3.1: no kilesaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no kileso na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ na dassanena
